title: 12. Can my participants answer my survey from a mobile device?
intent: This article explains the EUSurvey concept or feature: Can my participants answer my survey from a mobile device.
short_answer: Yes, EUSurvey features a responsive design for the published survey. This means, the design of the questionnaire will adapt to the resolution of the device used to enter your survey. This will allow your participants to conveniently contribute to your survey from a mobile device (mobile phone or tablet PC).
